4142437382: Grip Races are basically a straight up race, there are no handicaps so everyone is racing whatever they brought to the event. First one to cross the line wins!
4142437406: In Multiclass Grip Races cars are pre-screened when they enter the competition and are matched against the competitions' cars that are closest in performance. While all cars are on the track at the same time, you will only be competing against the cars in your class. Cars in your class are marked according to the group they belong to.
4142437407: Time Attack Grip Races are all about achieving the fastest lap time. All drivers will be given multiple laps to post the best time. Careful though, drivers are still on the track competing for time together, so things can still get pretty hairy. The driver holding the fastest lap time at the end of the event wins.
4142437408: Sector Shootout is a unique challenge where the tracks are divided into 4 sectors.  Drivers compete to own a sector by posting the highest points record for that sector.  Points are earned by beating the sector record. The more you beat a sector record by, the more points you earn.  If you can manage to claim all sectors during the event you'll be rewarded for dominating the sector shootout and earn bonus points. The driver with the most points at the end of the event wins.
4142437409: In Speed Challenge Races, cars compete in a race over a long distance. Keeping control of your car at high speeds is the key to success. Don't be afraid to let off the gas if things start getting a little too fast because at the end of the day you still need to cross the finish line to win.
4142437410: Top Speed Challenge is about posting the highest speeds at each checkpoint along the race. Every checkpoint registers your top speed the moment you pass through it. The driver with the highest cumulative speed through all checkpoints wins the event.
4142437411: Drag Racing is a competition between drivers to post the fastest drag time. In a Drag Tournament each driver gets 3 chances to post the fastest time. Staging well before each run and timing your shifts is the key to success.
4142437412: In Wheelie Competition cars compete to perform the longest wheelie. Similar to drag tournaments, each driver gets 3 chances to post the longest wheelie. To maintain a long wheelie, launch your car well and keep the nose up by timing your shifts. Use Nitrous to get the edge and keep your wheelie going for longer distances.
4142437413: In Drift Tournaments each opponent will take turns drifting on a course. Every driver will be scored based on speed, angle and how long they can hold a continuous drift. The faster you go and the higher the angle, the better you will score. Each driver gets 3 chances to post the best drift score, at the end of 3 rounds the driver with the highest score wins the event.
